analysis.reason: The request to /products/1 returned 404 with message "Requested item not found" while the test expected 200. The execution result alone does not indicate whether this is an application defect, missing or different test data in the environment, or an incorrect test expectation/contract assumption. No API contract, environment logs, or test-data setup information is provided to disambiguate the root cause.
analysis.recommendedAction: Investigate by: 1) Verifying the API contract/documentation to confirm whether product ID 1 is guaranteed to exist and should return 200. 2) Confirming test data/seeding for product ID 1 in the test environment. 3) Re-running the test and capturing server logs and full response headers to check for environment/authentication issues. 4) If product should exist, open an application defect; if not, update the test expectation or contract.
